title: feat(spec): the Ask source block's scope can state all_records when no row restriction applied
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRT27U1unc64yMdYqqPWFjw)_

Part of #33824
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names the Ask tools (`query_records`, `aggregate_data`, ...) but never their `source` block or its `scope`: `git grep` of `skills` for ObjectQuerySource, visible_to_you, all_records and resultSourceBlock answers 0 hits at this head

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:AI 问数回答附带的「来源」块里,`scope`(数据范围)从只能写「仅你可见的记录」一个值,扩成两个值:`visible_to_you`(这次查询受到了行级权限限制，组织隔离墙也算)和 `all_records`(安全服务 `getReadFilter` 在本次查询同一上下文里确实答了「无限制」)。拿不到答案(没有安全服务、没有这个方法、调用出错、上下文不同)一律写 `visible_to_you`。仍然必填、仍然只认这两个值。
- **为什么改**:组织所有者问「有几张紧急工单」,回答也带「只包含你有权限查看的记录」这句套话,因为契约里根本没有「没被限制」这个说法。本 PR 是席位路线 A(6918602381,非维护者裁决,请在批准时审读):用安全服务已经在执行的同一个判断来说明「是否受限」。**要你知道的一点**:在 `isolated` 和 `group` 两种租户形态下，组织墙本身就是一条行限制，所以组织所有者在带 `organization_id` 的对象上仍会得到 `visible_to_you`,套话照旧;只有 `single` 形态、租户外的对象、跨墙的平台管理员或系统上下文才可能是 `all_records`。staging 是哪种形态本 PR 没有测。「只限本组织」要不要也算「全部」,是产品决定，两个值表达不了，请在批准时一并确认。
- **风险与回滚**:只放宽、不收紧:以前能通过的来源块照样通过;控制台本来就只对 `visible_to_you` 画权限那一行,`all_records` 的块现在会正常显示且不带那一行(以前整块被丢弃)。失败方向永远是多说一句「仅你可见」,不会对受限的人谎称数据完整。回滚 = revert 本 PR。cloud 侧按此契约逐次填 `scope` 并改提示词，由 #34411 承载。
- **先看**:① `packages/spec/src/ai/object-query-source.zod.ts` 的 `scope` 定义与说明文字(契约本身);② `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.answerSource-31868.test.tsx` 新增的 `all_records` 不画权限行的钉子;③ `.changeset/33824-ask-source-scope-all-records.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/object-query-source.test.ts`,预期 11 个用例全过,其中 `all_records` 往返通过、未知值和缺失 `scope` 都在 `scope` 路径上以 `invalid_value` 被拒。
- **需要你做的**:审读并批准这个 Tier H 契约放宽(packages/spec);确认席位路线 A,以及「组织墙算行限制」这一读法(否则组织所有者在隔离形态下仍看到套话);合并由席位按流程处理。

## What changes

- `ObjectQuerySourceSchema.scope` (`packages/spec/src/ai/object-query-source.zod.ts`) is now `z.enum(['visible_to_you', 'all_records'])`, still required, no default. Its `.describe()` states both meanings as seat route A (6918602381) words them, and the two facts contract review asked the contract itself to carry: `visible_to_you` means a row restriction applied, and the organization wall is one, so under the `isolated` and `group` postures an organization owner reads `visible_to_you` on every object that carries `organization_id`; `all_records` is stated only when `ISecurityService.getReadFilter(object, ctx)` RESOLVED to `undefined` per call under the read's own context, which for a caller no row rule or sharing narrows is the `single` posture, an object outside tenancy, a platform admin crossing the wall, or a system context; an absent service, an absent method, a throw or rejection, or another context states `visible_to_you`. The value speaks for `object` only, not for `related` lookup paths. The schema header keeps its producer/reader sentences and ADR-0149 D3 rule 4, and says the same in short.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/ai/object-query-source.mdx` (via `gen:schema && gen:docs`). `authorable-surface/ai.json` is byte-unchanged: it lists keys, and `ObjectQuerySource:scope` was already there; the new accepted value is what makes this `Metadata-protocol: added`.
- Tests: the spec pin file, and the console's shared answer-source harness (one new top-level `describe`; one off-contract case changed from `all_records` to an unknown value, because `all_records` is now on contract). The console reader (`AnswerSource.tsx`, `mapMessages.ts`) needed no edit.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor.
- Not in this PR: the producer. `resultSourceBlock()`, the line wording and the agent prompt live in the cloud AI service; that half is carried by #34411. No producer of this block exists in this repo (`git grep resultSourceBlock` hits only the spec comment and a ui test docblock).

## Tests

- Spec (`src/ai/object-query-source.test.ts`, 11 tests): `all_records` round-trips; `all`, `visible`, `ALL_RECORDS` and the empty string are each refused with exactly one issue `[scope, invalid_value]`; a block with no `scope` is refused with `[scope, invalid_value]`.
- Console (`ChatbotEnhanced.answerSource-31868.test.tsx`): an `all_records` block parses and lifts whole; expanded, it draws its rows and no `answer-source-scope` line, in the `en` fallback and the shipped zh pack (no 仅包含你可见的记录); `visible_to_you` still draws its line; an unknown scope and a missing scope still lift nothing and draw no block.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): with the fix committed, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put `z.literal('visible_to_you')` back (anchor x1 to x0, blob f46b0f6f to 42984337); the spec file went red, `1 failed | 10 passed (11)`, the failure being the `all_records` round-trip; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob back to f46b0f6f. The spec test imports the schema from `src`, so no dist was involved.

## Acceptance notes

- `visible_to_you` is the complement of `all_records`: any answer from `getReadFilter` other than `undefined` (a restricting filter, the organization wall, or the fail-closed DENY filter) is a restriction applied, and so is no answer at all. The contract (not only the changeset) says so.
- Card acceptance 2 (an organization owner gets no caveat) is met by this contract only where the organization wall contributes nothing: the `single` posture, an object outside tenancy, a platform admin crossing the wall. Under `isolated` and `group` the owner still reads `visible_to_you` on tenant objects. The posture of the staging environment was not measured. Whether "restricted to my own organization" should read as all records is a product decision, put to the approver with seat route A.
- Before this PR the console dropped a whole `source` block whose scope was `all_records` (the existing harness pinned that as off-contract). From this PR, it draws that block, without the access line.
- Card acceptance 1 (labels in the answer and its source line) and the per-call `scope` value are both cloud work, #34411. This PR only gives that producer a way to say "no row restriction applied".

## Verification

The delta is one commit: the `scope` description and the header sentence in `object-query-source.zod.ts`, the regenerated `content/docs/references/ai/object-query-source.mdx` row, and the changeset prose. No schema shape, test or export moved.
